title: recruiting-coordinator-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-05
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick notes & to-dos (Kelly)
Date: 2026-03-05

TOP PRIORITIES:
- [ ] Confirm onsite travel approvals for Samira Patel by EOD (req: manager sign-off).
- [ ] Send interview loop invite to Alex Chen (backend SWE) - hold 1.5h panel; include take-home instructions.
- [ ] Follow up with recruiting lead about compensation band for Senior PM role (needed for offer).

MORNING INBOX / QUICK ACTIONS:
- 08:30 - Reply to candidate support emails: reschedule requests (Ben, Priya).
- 09:00 - Calendar sync: block buffer before interviews (15m).
- 09:15 - Quick check: background check vendor flagged missing I-9 for hire-123. Ping HR Ops (Jordan).

CANDIDATE NOTES / NEXT STEPS:
- Alex Chen (SWE Backend) - phone screen done 3/3. Wants 4pm PT on Tue/Thu for onsite. TODO: send interview loop, include take-home repo link + instructions. Note: prefers West coast times.
- Samira Patel (Senior PM) - onsite debrief 3/4: hiring managers + feedback mostly positive. ACTION: get final comp approval, prepare draft offer template. Potential start: mid-April.
- Ben Ortiz (SWE IC) - asked to reschedule 3/6 -> propose 3/9 10am PT. He indicated preference for remote-only interview.
- Maria Gomez (Data Scientist) - outstanding coding assignment, sent reminder 3/2; follow-up if no submission by 3/6.

SCHEDULING / CALENDAR NOTES:
- Interview buffer rules: 15m prep, 10m debrief. Add to invites as "buffer required".
- Room booking: Onsite rooms C2/C3 reserved 3/12; confirm with office ops.
- Timezone reminder: include candidate timezone in invite title (e.g., "Interview - Maria Gomez - 11am ET").

TEMPLATES / SNIPPETS (for quick copy)
- Reschedule reply: "Hi {Candidate}, thanks for letting us know - we can move your interview to {options}. Please confirm which works best and I'll send updated invites."
- Offer prep note to hiring manager: "Hi {Manager}, feedback looks strong for {Candidate}. Can you confirm target comp band and ideal start date so I can draft the offer?"

FOLLOW-UPS (this week)
- Tue 3/10: Reminder to hiring teams for loop feedback due within 48h of interview.
- Wed 3/11: Check on signed offers and kickoff background checks for accepted candidates.

RISKS / BLOCKERS:
- Comp band for Senior PM unclear - blocking offer. Contact finance/comp soon.
- Background check delays from vendor for international candidates (allow extra 5 business days).

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep copy of candidate Slack pings in case of no-show (timestamp + who reached out).
- Trim invite attendees to necessary interviewers only - avoid "FYI" guests in loop.

LINKS / QUICK REFERENCES:
- Interview loop rubric: https://confluence.redwood.ai/PeopleOps/Interview-Rubrics
- Offer templates folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/PeopleOps/Offers

END-OF-DAY CHECKLIST:
- [ ] Confirm all interview invites sent for next 72h.
- [ ] Update candidate tracker sheet with statuses.
- [ ] Log/close any open scheduling threads in Slack.

Random notes / brain dump:
- Consider adding short "candidate timezone" field to intake form to reduce back-and-forth.
- Add one-sheeter for take-home exercise expectations to reduce questions from candidates.
